el Poble-sec — Barcelona, Spain

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

No reports of assault, robbery patterns, or no-go conditions targeting visitors were found for Poble-sec; an idealista.com neighbourhood safety guide (2025) explicitly recommends it. The one documented issue is property crime against parked cars (Mossos arrested a man in Feb 2025 for smashing windows on 18 parked vehicles near Montjuïc), not pedestrians, so no elevated rating is warranted. Sources checked: idealista.com, Sept 2025; Barna Diario, Feb 2025.
